research_question: Can an interpretable local-pose basis mixture or a pair-conditioned local-pose rotary score improve development-only geometry use without changing the frozen eight-condition matrix?

hypotheses.primary: Across the five locked seeds, local_pose_multibasis improves the validation reciprocal-min interaction-only margin relative to full_pose without reducing mean per-complex contact AUPRC by more than 0.005.
hypotheses.secondary: local_pose_rotary is retained only if it improves the same primary endpoint and passes all invariance, missing-frame, and calibration gates; novelty alone is not a promotion criterion.
hypotheses.mechanistic: For a retained method, geometry shuffle, local-frame corruption, and neighbor rewiring reduce the validation endpoint while independent rigid transforms preserve predictions within the registered numerical tolerance.

data.split: reciprocal-min Foldseek antigen-fold development roles inherited from parent v5

training_objective.contact: observed-class-balanced BCE on authenticated cognate residue-pair labels
training_objective.specificity: mean softplus ranking loss over both reciprocal counterfactual directions
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: wrong pairs are ranking examples and never receive fabricated all-zero contact labels

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum of the two validation cluster-weighted directional interaction-only margins; break ties within 0.0001 by validation mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch
model_selection.reporting: report every seed, failures, parameter counts, calibration, and intervention diagnostics

promotion_gate.frozen_test_action: forbidden under this exploratory protocol; a new selection-free opening receipt is required after development selection is frozen

claim_boundary: Post-hoc, development-only exploratory comparison. It cannot alter the frozen eight-condition confirmatory result and does not authorize frozen-test, external, benchmark, or state-of-the-art claims.
